        (CAST(processed_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(opened_at AS TIMESTAMP)) / (60 * 60 * 24) AS processing_days

WITH multi_dept_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        goal_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT department) AS dept_count
    FROM data
    GROUP BY goal_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT department) > 1
),
multi_dept_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        m.goal_id,
        d.department,
        d.goal_met
    FROM multi_dept_goals m
    JOIN data d ON m.goal_id = d.goal_id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_multi_dept_goals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN goal_met = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goals_met,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN goal_met = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS success_rate
FROM multi_dept_stats

         LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user, amount, short_description, category ORDER BY opened_at) AS prev_opened_at
  FROM data

    SELECT user, amount, short_description, category
    FROM data
    GROUP BY user, amount, short_description, category
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  )
)

FROM duplicates
WHERE prev_opened_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY user

WITH finance_goals AS (

    target_percentage,

  WHERE completion_days > (SELECT AVG(completion_days) FROM finance_goals)

)

args.query:
WITH duplicate_claims AS (
    SELECT 
        caller_id AS user,
        category,
        short_description,
        opened_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY caller_id, category, short_description ORDER BY opened_at) as rn
    FROM data
    WHERE (caller_id, category, short_description) IN (
        SELECT caller_id, category, short_description
        FROM data
        GROUP BY caller_id, category, short_description
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
),
claim_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        dc1.user,
        dc1.category,
        dc1.short_description,
        dc1.opened_at as first_claim_time,
        dc2.opened_at as second_claim_time,
        julianday(dc2.opened_at) - julianday(dc1.opened_at) as days_difference
    FROM duplicate_claims dc1
    JOIN duplicate_claims dc2 ON dc1.user = dc2.user 
        AND dc1.category = dc2.category 
        AND dc1.short_description = dc2.short_description 
        AND dc1.rn = dc2.rn - 1
)
SELECT 
    user,
    category,
    short_description,
    COUNT(*) as repeat_count,
    AVG(days_difference) as avg_days_between_claims
